description: READ THIS BEFORE WRITING ANY MESSAGE TO A PERSON on the owner's behalf (email, chat, social DM), in any language. Compiled from EMAIL-REVIEW-CONTRACT.md; never edit by hand.
usage: Every drafting entry point reads this before writing; the critic checks the draft against the same ledger after the fact and logs hit lines.
In front: what the hit counts say is still needed. Assumed: still checked, back in front the moment it fires.
procedure: Find the thread and the language first ({R:thread}, {R:language}).
Write the ask first ({R:ask-first}), short ({R:short}), no filler ({R:no-filler}).
Verify every attachment and link you mention exists ({R:no-false-attachment}).

rules.rule: The ask goes first, subject included; propose one concrete time instead of asking for availability.
At most five sentences for a first message.

rules.example: start with the point, not "I hope this finds you well"

rules.rule: Write in the language the person last wrote in.
Never claim an attachment or a link that is not actually there.
